Agent instruction scripts: For the Script panel, use get_project and update_project.script_lines. Preserve the full ordered list, stable line IDs and existing audio metadata. After import_asset or generate_voice_take with project_id, attach the real asset ID, audio_source and original audio_text to its line with the latest confirmed revision. Plain script replacement clears line audio associations. Generate all is a per-line loop that preserves manual takes. Microphone recording is controlled in the browser.
